details:
This update for openssl-3 fixes the following issues:

- Build with enable-sslkeylog to support the SSLKEYLOGFILE
  environment variable usage. (jsc#PED-17079)

- Allow to bypass the strict tag initialization and length
  enforcement added in the fix for CVE-2026-34182 when the env
  variable OPENSSL_ALLOW_CMS_UNAUTHENTICATED_AEAD is defined and
  set to a non-zero value. (bsc#1281325)

package.name: openssl-3
package.ecosystem: SUSE:Linux Enterprise Module for Basesystem 15 SP7
